title: Having: Van egy autóm, autónk, autójuk

sections.title: Having, for every person
sections.content: You know *Van egy testvérem* ('I have a sibling') from the family lessons. Hungarian says 'there is a sibling of mine', and the ending shows who has it. The same works for every person: just change the ending. To say you don't have something, use *nincs*.

There is no word for 'have'. *Van egy autónk* is literally 'there is a car of ours'. Leave out the ending and the owner disappears: *Van egy autó* only says 'there is a car'. After *nincs*, *egy* drops out: *Nincs autónk*.
